fields.description: Issue includes editorials and reporting on gambling and racing in Greater Miami, including discussion of the Miami Beach Beach and Tennis Club and enforcement of anti-gambling policies; coverage of a police brutality hearing involving Officer G. A. Denny and the civil service board; notes on local government and proposed public works including a federal negro housing project and sewage disposal plans; and extensive racing and nightlife content, advertisements, and columns (including “Jockey Jimmy” selections) tied to Tropical Park and local clubs. Masthead: “Florida’s Most Influential Weekly,” published Saturdays by Life Publishing Company; executive offices listed at the Professional Building, Miami.
